appDescription: Gachita records car conversations with every passenger's consent. It lets the driver start, pause and resume conversation recording.

function.name: GACHITA_START_RECORDING
function.description: Start recording the car conversation when parked after all passengers have consented. This does not grant consent or resume a paused recording.

function.name: GACHITA_PAUSE_RECORDING
function.description: Pause the current car conversation recording without revoking consent or deleting saved records.

function.name: GACHITA_RESUME_RECORDING
function.description: Resume the previously paused car conversation recording with existing passenger consent.
